comment: Path exemptions for naming-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a path, a reason, and a ticket; an entry missing any of the three is ignored, so an exemption cannot take effect without a reviewable justification. Use a real issue number for tech debt that should be burned down, or `policy:AGENTS.md` for a permanent carve-out where a real name is load-bearing and a placeholder would break the file. Removing an entry re-arms the gate for that path. Paths are relative to the scan root: the repository root in canonical, the module root in a consumer copy.

paths.reason: A copyright notice must name the real legal rights holder; a placeholder would make the licence unenforceable.
GitHub resolves review assignment against real account handles; a placeholder silently disables code-owner review rather than failing loudly.
Machine-generated from commit metadata, so author names are reproduced mechanically. Regenerate the baseline rather than hand-editing it; hand-edits are overwritten on the next run.

Holds the ONE literal filesystem path the delivery trust anchor is mounted at. It must match byte-for-byte what the platform infrastructure renders and pins, in a different repository, or the host reads a path nothing writes — which fails closed at boot forever and invites someone to 'fix' it by making the path configurable again, restoring the seam that let a composition choose the anchor its own documents are verified against. A placeholder here would break the file in the strict sense: the constant would name a directory that does not exist. Scoped to this one file deliberately; every other reference in this repository cites the Go constant rather than repeating the literal, so there is one source of truth and nothing to drift.

Holds the ONE literal path the witness log's Ed25519 signing key is mounted at, by the same rule as the delivery trust anchor: no path argument, no environment override, so the location is out of reach of anything the composition supplies. It must match byte-for-byte what the platform infrastructure renders, in a different repository, or the service reads a path nothing writes and refuses to boot forever — and the obvious 'fix' is to make the path configurable, which is the seam this design deletes. A placeholder here would name a directory that does not exist. Scoped to this one file: every other reference cites the Go constant rather than repeating the literal.
